read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved; no guessed path or broad archive read. Fresh MISSION_STATE plus exact-current v1/v2/v2.1 executable/tests/contracts and QUANTUM_LATEST control this review.

agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only and must never become verified Experience by category alone.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, reconnect, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
Safety/recovery downshift is not blocked by the current anti-thrash branch because the hold applies only to selected_n > current_n.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and does not exceed the inherited v2 gear; keep it observational.
formal_mutation_allowed=false; P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance remain outside v2.1 write authority.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2/v2.1 is rejected.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied and not strict runtime booleans; stale signals can be presented as fresh and truthy strings can alter control flow.
disagreements.required_change: Replace free booleans with replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus trusted authority comparison; reject non-bool/unbound controls fail-closed.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only converts secretary_level to UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so permissive caller v2 inputs can still route above an authority-required recovery gear.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope/exact authority snapshot and project its safe decision or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied and directly controls v2 one-step hysteresis plus v2.1 anti-thrash. A forged high current_gear can relax the effective upshift path; a forged low value can create artificial holds/performance degradation.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash; caller value may be advisory only and mismatch must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied. Self-reporting C_VERIFIED removes the v2 UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE G4 cap without any exact C evidence, verifier identity, mission/step/scope, freshness or revocation binding.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage from a trusted verifier/acceptance receipt bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence and current acceptance state; missing/stale/revoked/cross-scope receipts retain the unverified cap.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied, has no canonical shift-ledger provenance, and >=0.50 has no sample-count/window/confidence semantics; 1/1 or 2/3 can trigger hold.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift records with numerator, denominator, observation window, sample count, runtime identity and policy hash; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can suppress safe upshift indefinitely, lower apparent shift rate, and still worsen cycle completion, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/cooldown/release behavior and require paired performance non-regression before claiming benefit.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience depends on event kind plus bool(independently_verified), not exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; bool('false') is True.
disagreements.required_change: Strict bool fail-closed is necessary but insufficient; require canonical event/evidence identity, trusted verifier receipt, scope/freshness/revocation and durable acceptance record.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe is transient per aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, same ID across restarts/polls/rollback, or same ID rebound to different evidence can all re-credit without a durable identity/lineage registry.
disagreements.required_change: Seal immutable EventIdentity and evidence lineage in a rollback-resistant accepted-event registry; exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate, same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Use one AcceptedExperienceReceipt authority path for both verified Experience and operational progress; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated interval-scale measurements.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate score as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline, precommit, uncertainty or non-inferiority protocol exists for the named speed metrics.
disagreements.required_change: Use matched workload paired baseline with durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency; commit count and awake time are forbidden evidence.

disagreements.finding: durable_progress_per_wake can improve solely by changing wake/coalescing cadence or eligible-wake definition.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit/freeze canonical eligible-wake definition and scheduler policy; bind numerator and denominator to durable runtime records and require corroboration by wall-clock closure/latency metrics.

disagreements.finding: verified_closure_per_hour can be gamed if baseline and candidate use different observation horizons or censor idle, blocked, recovery, verifier-wait or failure periods differently.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit paired observation horizon, exposure-clock definition, start/stop rule, downtime/censoring policy, interrupted-run handling and workload arrival process.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage changes routing exposure and invalidates causal speed comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance and can create false anti-thrash holds.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density has no bound denominator/window/independence and becomes self-reinforcing if later wired to routing.
Transient event identity and dual credit paths permit longitudinal verified/operational credit inflation.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive to candidate-dependent wake cadence.
verified_closure_per_hour is sensitive to candidate-dependent observation-window selection and downtime/failure censoring.
Unmatched baseline/candidate runs are confounded by workload mix, incident rate, verifier availability, runtime conditions and routing state.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE cannot affect gear using caller-forged freshness; non-bool freshness/conflict values reject fail-closed.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery plus permissive caller fallback still produces G1; stale/revoked/cross-scope authority receipts reject.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-034: canonical runtime=G1 while caller says G5; hysteresis/anti-thrash must use canonical G1 and record mismatch.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-035: caller says C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt; retain unverified cap; stale/revoked/cross-step/cross-install receipts reject.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017: canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller recent_shift_rate_ratio.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 cannot trigger production anti-thrash without preregistered support/uncertainty semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: after a burst, safe upshift recovers under bounded policy with non-regressed closure/cycle/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: same canonical evidence under 10,000 IDs credits once.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020: exactly-once acceptance survives calls, restart, rollback and repeated polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021: same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt receives zero verified credit; non-bool verification flags reject.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 / OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: 10,000 receipt-less decision calls create zero additional verified or operational credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate 5/4/3 scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.
GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015: matched baseline reports all required speed and quality metrics with verification/risk non-regression; commits/awake time excluded.
GB21-WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 and RATIO-GAMING-031: freeze eligible-wake policy and reject ratio-only gains from fewer counted wakes.
GB21-TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 and CENSORING-GAMING-033: identical exposure clock/censoring rules remove artificial closure-per-hour gains.
release_condition: Do not modify formal authority and do not claim C PASS from this review.
Fresh secretary and authority decisions must be evidence-bound and replay-resistant, with strict input typing.
current_gear and verification_stage must come from trusted canonical runtime/verifier state, not caller declarations.
Anti-thrash metrics must come from canonical shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded release behavior.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance; operational progress remains separate.
All verified/operational credit must flow through one durable replay-resistant acceptance registry/receipt path.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window age/runtime uptime remain zero Experience; P_base remains read-only.
5/4/3/1 weights remain TEST_REQUIRED heuristics and cannot establish capability truth or promotion.

Any speedup claim requires matched paired baseline, precommitted workload and observation/exposure windows, identical wake/censoring policy, all five core speed metrics, uncertainty, and verification/risk non-regression.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2.1 is rejected.
